title: Construct a common physical code with moving Gaussian stages (no new κ)
body:
The center-free native word leaves stage-dependent physical owner codes. This package constructs a common code by inserting explicit coordinate swaps on the main inputs. The resulting stages are `E_s=P_s D_0`; their distinct-stage products retain 8k Gaussian axes after an explicit monomial removal. It also proves that a common code is impossible for any stage-local monomial normalizers with the stated distinct-line images.

The direct caller substitution still fails: `[C_0,E_s Q]=0` is equivalent to `[C_0,P_s]=0`, and every one of the actual 5,824 nonzero code blocks rejects it. The construction is retained as a changed local interface with a precise next obligation. No new κ, completed supplier, selected-frontier update or theorem result is claimed.

Only `research/common-code-moving-stages` is added. PROOF.md gives the support-intersection argument, arbitrary-input F/B endpoints, all-width lift, stage-word induction, failure gate and obligation ledger. The transport adds 224 main-field monomial maps per FULL and eight anchor axes. Their finite-tape price, spectators, completion, restoration, caller, precision and recursive compiler/outer obligations remain open; unknown costs are not zero.

Validation: mathematical replay and Git-free optimized replay at `d87301c0faee971d492091ce8b7314233ec51c6b`; final head `b893ba6bd6c77c6e7efc48acb6f448218df671b7` adds only the explicit nonzero lower-left gauge block to PROOF.md. The verifier, receipt and all inputs are unchanged. Committed-byte and official export/integrity checks also pass at the final head.

- CPython 3.12 registered normal and optimized replay passed: 112 normalizers, 57,344 phase congruences, 5,824 complete code blocks, 1,956 ordered distinct-stage words and 3,912 independent finite-field vector comparisons, with positive and failure controls.
- Committed-byte preflight and 11-file official export/integrity check passed. Portable Git-free optimized replay passed from the extracted export with Git absent from PATH.
- Canonical main refreshed before submission and remains `81e9bd69e4a5b00ba9c713a1620e36d576d5522e`; selected conditional κ remains .00302015. Source pins are all at that exact direct parent. The optional full source-history preflight declines this shallow checkout; the commit parent and an explicit ancestry check confirm the sole pin commit is the direct parent. No full-history replay is claimed.
- No native-word regeneration, full controller/compiler/BIT/outer replay, Lean proof or independent human review was run. Hosted CI has not yet reported checks at the final head.

Canonical claim and overlap: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4930#discussioncomment-19142768. Coverage: 320 open PRs, 4,233 Discussion records and 6,824 local notes, plus specific common-code/moving-coordinate terms. Body/note searches are not proof of novelty.

Credit Dillon/PR4933, Dugongue/mdumitrean/PR4929, Cayden Burkart/PR4940, JoyboyBrian/PR4936, Cao Yifan/PR4610, Cinna Davis/PR4694/4698/4470, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and the full retained native/compiler/precision lineage. Prepared by Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0.

Open next questions are a changed complete caller for the moving endpoints, a priced anchor/spectator contract, and a favorable complete moment before further implementation expansion.
